summary: Master IFRS and IAS standards with our comprehensive training program. Enhance your skills and boost your career in finance and accounting today!
lede: IFRS and IAS standards training helps finance professionals apply reporting requirements to transactions and financial statements. It is designed for accountants, analysts, finance managers and auditors who prepare, review or communicate financial reporting, with practice in revenue recognition, lease accounting, and classifying and measuring financial instruments. Learners also work with fair value measurement, impairment testing, and disclosure preparation across standards including IFRS 13, IAS 36 and IAS 37.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who must interpret, apply, and communicate IFRS and IAS standards in real-world operational contexts. Financial Director:
audience: Set strategy and report consolidated results
Chief Accountant: Oversee daily IFRS/IAS compliance
Audit Manager: Lead internal audits of revenue
Senior Financial Analyst: Model fair value
Internal Audit Lead: Test controls over provisions
Financial Reporting Manager: Prepare disclosure checklists
Budget Accountant: Align budget forecasts with IFRS
Credit Controller: Assess loan impairment and ECL
Procurement Director: Manage lease contracts and ROU
Compliance Officer: Ensure adherence to IAS 37
modules: The IFRS Framework and IAS 1 Presentation
IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers
prerequisites: Participants must have a working knowledge of double-entry accounting and basic financial statement preparation. No coding or advanced programming is required. A laptop with Excel is essential for hands-on exercises using real-world financial scenarios.
